# Audit Requirements Checklist: Unify Audit Events

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, and testability of unified audit requirements
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are all source-to-Audit field mappings, description context, and explicitly discarded fields documented? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-002–FR-007]
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements clear about which identifiers remain as structured audit fields and which identifiers must not be retained? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-005–FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 - Are description requirements defined separately for new deletion events and historical deletion records that lack recoverable context? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-005, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 - Is “Description MUST NOT contain IDs” clear enough to distinguish human-readable names from identifier values while preserving ActingUserId and excluding AccountId? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-005–FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 - Are transaction/account descriptions, the `OccurredAtUtc` event timestamp, and the exclusion of review outcomes/dates specified clearly enough to avoid inconsistent or invented details? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the required generic description for historical deletions sufficiently specified for consistent interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 - Are immutability requirements consistent across the acceptance scenarios, functional requirements, entity lifecycle, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §User Scenarios, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-009, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §Success Criteria SC-005]
- [x] CHK008 - Are field-preservation requirements consistent with retaining ActingUserId while discarding TransactionId, ReviewId, and AccountId? [Consistency, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-002–FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK009 - Can complete migration coverage be objectively assessed against the requirement to preserve 100% of source events exactly once? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-001]
- [x] CHK010 - Are the success criteria sufficient to judge all mapped values and deletion-description constraints without relying on implementation details? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria SC-002–SC-004]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK011 - Are partial migration, retry, and failure-recovery outcomes defined without permitting existing Audit records to be changed or deleted? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-007–FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 - Are requirements complete for missing historical transaction context while requiring a nonblank account description in every Audit Description? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 - Are requirements clear about whether duplicate source events or repeated migration attempts may create duplicate Audit records? [Gap, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-007, FR-010]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK014 - Are the required controls for enforcing Audit immutability across all write paths and persistence-level operations stated at a requirements level? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-009, Spec §Success Criteria SC-005]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK015 - Are assumptions about retaining ActingUserId and removing AccountId documented without implying that descriptions may contain IDs? [Consistency, Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK016 - Are migration ordering, source-table retirement, and recovery constraints documented consistently with immutable Audit retention? [Dependency, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-007–FR-009]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [x] CHK017 - Does the specification distinguish an Audit record's own identity from the prohibited TransactionId, ReviewId, and AccountId references? [Ambiguity, Spec §Key Entities, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-006]
- [x] CHK018 - Are any unresolved requirements left for account context in Description, account deletion behavior, historical retention, or correction records that could change the data model or acceptance criteria? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-009, FR-011]
- [x] CHK019 - Are EventCode and Description both required and nonblank for every Audit record, including imports and historical backfill? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements FR-002–FR-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
